heroTitle: Industrial Automation for Power, Oil & Gas and Process Industries

blocks.html: Since 2007 we have designed, integrated and commissioned automation on power plants, refineries, cement works and control rooms.
Emerson Ovation, ABB 800xA and Industrial IT, Siemens PCS7, Yokogawa Centum VP, HIMA HIQuad and Triconex — documented to the same standards on every project, and held to the same test evidence.
Quality management certified to ISO 9001 since 2009.

blocks.alt: HomeMaster retail boxes for OpenTherm Gateway, Digital I/O, Analog I/O, Water Leak, MicroPLC and Energy Meter modules

blocks.html: Our in-house DIN-rail brand: local logic on every module, RS-485 Modbus between devices, ESPHome and Home Assistant integration — no cloud required. Shop, configurator and docs at home-master.eu.

blocks.alt: Hydro turbine and generator set in the machine hall

blocks.html: We automate electricity and heat production — steam and gas turbines, boilers, HRSG, hydro, district heating and renewable dispatch — from control system design through commissioning and acceptance testing.

blocks.alt: ATEX Zone 2 intrinsically safe isolating barriers in a control cabinet

blocks.html: Refinery and gas plants need control systems that work in classified areas, keep the refinery supplied when the grid fails, and report emissions and efficiency to the people who act on the data. We design intrinsically safe I&C, burner management and SIL-rated safety systems, and integrate process data into the plant DCS and historians.

blocks.alt: Bulk material handling and weigh batching plant

blocks.html: Conveyors, bins, crushers, belt weighers and recipe dosing — the same control problems whether the material feeds a boiler, an asphalt plant or a concrete batching plant.

blocks.alt: Combined-cycle plant control room with operator consoles and overview display

blocks.html: ISYSTEMS AUTOMATION designs, manufactures and supplies control room equipment and operator furniture for LUKOIL Energy and Gas, Dalkia Termo Prahova and Nuclearelectrica. Layout, acoustics, lighting and reach distances are decided with the control system — an operator on the eleventh hour of a night shift still has to read the screen and hear the alarm.
